evals.prompt: Update our old threejs-physics-audio integration. Keep physics, listener setup, Web Audio nodes, collision subscriptions, and all teardown in one singleton. Every predicted and reconciled contact should play the same sound.
evals.expected_output: A compatibility route that preserves the old entry point but assigns simulation to threejs-physics-simulation and sound to threejs-spatial-audio, defines a typed collision-to-cue event contract, deduplicates prediction and reconciliation, and keeps lifecycle independent.
assertions: The response preserves threejs-physics-audio as a compatibility route rather than deleting it.
Physics-only ownership is delegated to threejs-physics-simulation.
Audio-only ownership is delegated to threejs-spatial-audio.
The cross-system boundary carries semantic event identity, tick or timing, position, and a deduplication key.
Physics and audio can initialize, fail, and tear down independently.
